correctness.rationale: The squarefree-monomial decomposition and Frobenius prove characteristic-two normal forms and automorphism transfer of annihilators. In odd characteristic the degree-two coefficient comparison and unit cancellation show only coordinate ideals. Uniqueness follows by comparing the two complementary summands; finite counts follow from projective fibers. Eight standalone exhaustive matrix-of-multiplication cases, including F4, corroborate the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: Self-paired exact zero divisors form a natural subclass of a standard homological-algebra invariant. Uniform all-dimension classification over arbitrary fields and exact finite-field enumeration reveal a sharp structural and geometric characteristic jump, with projective base and exponentially growing affine fiber; this is materially stronger than existence of known coordinate examples.
